i.norm:
Tests that {@link SparseBloomFilter#merge(Hasher)} correctly populates the filter's internal index set from a hasher's output.

The filter under test uses {@link Shape#fromKM(int, int)} with k=17 hash functions and m=72 bits.

After merging a hasher, the filter must contain exactly the distinct, sorted bit-indices that the hasher produced — duplicates are deduplicated and order is normalised, matching {@link BloomFilter#asIndexArray()}.
The shape shared by all filters in this test class: k=17, m=72.

Verifies that merging a {@link Hasher} into an empty {@link SparseBloomFilter} sets exactly the bit-indices produced by the hasher, deduplicated and in ascending order.

The loop runs five times with independently generated random index arrays so the assertion is exercised across different input patterns.
Generate a random array of raw indices with one entry per hash function.
Wrap the raw indices in a Hasher so the filter can consume them.
The filter must store the same indices as the hasher produced, but deduplicated and sorted — matching asIndexArray() contract.
